spiritual_reading.full_translation: Every opening of worship and every motion of turning toward the Divine begins from the wisdom-principle that proceeds first in holiness, because without wisdom no blessing is formed and no prayer is received. Every beginning of sound counsel and every true ordering of what is useful begins from the governing truth that administers the lower realm of reception under the Divine source of all illumination. Every beginning of genuine reverence and every act of honoring begins from love united with wisdom, for love is what makes the Divine precious and truly acknowledged. Every beginning of the power that searches, detects, and exposes what is hidden begins from the first engagement of good in human form against evil, by which what is harmful is tracked and brought into judgment. Every beginning of the power that contends in spiritual conflict begins from living Divine operation, the origin of vitality, which has established a sufficient complement of operative powers in distinct functions throughout the whole field of reception. Every beginning of the power that designs and builds stable forms for life begins from the Divine ordering that shapes every true framework of thought and use in glory. Every beginning of the strength that bears what is weighty in the ultimate degree begins from the steadfast ultimate support by which higher things stand in the lowest plane and are held together. Every beginning of deliverance begins from Divine truth made manifest in clarity, which frees whatever is capable of salvation from falsities that bind, dissolving them by its own utterance and presence. Every beginning of wisdom that is truly of truth begins from pure receptivity for illumination without self-claim, through which truth is conceived and kept untainted for life. Every beginning of the most honored states within the domains of the mind begins from enlightened understanding, which awakens those in obscurity and gathers back into order those whose interior things have been scattered.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every opening of blessing and every act of prayer begins from the wisdom-principle that proceeds first in holiness.
paragraph_translations.connection: BEGINS the chapter by establishing wisdom as the first source of worshipful approach.
paragraph_translations.notes: "Mother of Life" and "first Holy Spirit" require functional reading; rendered as wisdom proceeding as first sanctity.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of good counsel and of true arrangement for use begins from the governing truth that reigns within the lower realm of reception and administers it under the Divine source of all illumination.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the theme by moving from worship to discernment and governance in lower reception.
paragraph_translations.notes: The damaged wording around stewardship and ordaining forced a generalized rendering of administration under the source of light.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of reverence and every act of honoring begins from love united with wisdom, which is received as what is most precious.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by grounding honor and reverence in the primacy of love.
paragraph_translations.notes: The exact nuance of “honour (?)” is unclear; treated as acknowledgment and due regard.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of the power that searches out and exposes what is hidden begins from the first engagement of good in human form against evil.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from internal devotion to the initial mode of spiritual detection and pursuit.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Trappers and hunters” pressed toward a spiritual faculty of tracking concealed evils/falsities; somewhat uncertain.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of the power that fights in spiritual conflict begins from living Divine operation, the origin of vitality, which has established a sufficient complement of operative powers in distinct functions throughout the whole field of reception.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the conflict theme by describing living operation distributing powers for combat.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Five sons” translated by number as sufficiency of operative powers; “from place to place” rendered as distinct functions/degrees.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of the power that designs and builds stable forms for life begins from the Divine ordering that gives shape to every true structure of thought and use in glory.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from combat to the constructive ordering of spiritual life.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Architects and builders” rendered as formative powers that arrange frameworks.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of the strength that bears what is weighty in the ultimate degree begins from the steadfast ultimate support by which higher things stand and are held together.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the constructive theme by moving to ultimate supports and stability.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Porters” and “pillar” required an ultimate-support reading; “worlds” treated as degrees/domains held together.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of deliverance begins from Divine truth made manifest in clarity, which frees whatever is capable of salvation from falsities that bind, dissolving them by its own utterance and presence.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to liberation and the undoing of bondage through manifest truth.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Bonds of Darkness” rendered as binding falsities/evils; “from his words” treated as freeing by utterance/presence.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of wisdom that is truly of truth begins from pure receptivity for illumination without self-claim, through which truth is conceived and kept untainted for life.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by identifying the condition that receives genuine truth-wisdom.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Virgin” required the sense of untainted receptivity; the broken ending of the line offers no further qualifiers.

paragraph_translations.translation: Every beginning of the most honored states within the domains of the mind begins from enlightened understanding, which awakens those in obscurity and gathers back into order those whose interior things have been dispersed.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONCLUDES by naming enlightened understanding as the source of awakening and reintegration.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Worlds” rendered as domains/levels of mind; “sleep” treated as obscurity; “scattered” treated as dispersed thoughts/affections.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strongly coherent as a litany of first-principles: each spiritual function (worship, counsel, reverence, detection, combat, building, sustaining, delivering, receiving truth, awakening) is traced to its originating Divine attribute or operation. The voice is consistent, though several titles are opaque and a few damaged phrases force generalized renderings rather than sharply distinguished functions.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential opening: a functional claim about worship’s source; no narrative break and no jurisdictional cataloging beyond the fixed title.
findings.evidence: Text: “The beginning of each blessing and every prayer is the Mother of Life, the first Holy Spirit.” The spiritual reading did not stumble here; it could render a functional sense (“wisdom-principle… first in holiness”) because the sentence teaches by source-function (what makes blessing/prayer begin), not by who governs territories.

findings.diagnosis: Mixed voice with an administrative seep: the line begins as a functional ‘beginning of counsel’ maxim, but the added predicates (“king… realm… steward and ordainer”) shift into governance/jurisdiction and force the reader to generalize. Likely an expansion at a seam inside an otherwise correspondential formula.
findings.evidence: Text: “the beginning of every good counsel is the Third Ambassador, the king of the glorious realm that lies in this world, [the steward and ordainer] of the King of the lights.” The spiritual reading explicitly reports being forced into generalities: “The damaged wording around stewardship and ordaining forced a generalized rendering of administration under the source of light.” The correspondential core is ‘good counsel begins from X’; the rest is administrative rank-and-realm language (“king,” “realm,” “steward,” “ordainer,” “King of the lights”) that does not contribute a functional mechanism of counsel-making.
findings.scope:
Excise the administrative expansion while keeping the correspondential frame:
Remove: “, the king of the glorious realm that lies in this [wo]rld, [the steward and ordainer] of the King of the lights”

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential continuation; slight lexical uncertainty is genuine difficulty, not insertion. The sentence remains a functional ‘beginning of honour/reverence’ mapping.
findings.evidence: Text: “The beginning of [reverence and] each [hono]ur (?) is the Beloved of the Lights…” The reader notes only minor uncertainty (“honour (?) is unclear”) but no narrative break; the structure stays parallel to ¶2 and keeps to function (honouring begins from the Beloved).

findings.diagnosis: Correspondential but semantically opaque (metaphor problem), not administrative intrusion. ‘Trappers and hunters’ is hard to convert into a stable spiritual function, yet it still follows the chapter’s functional-litany form.
findings.evidence: Text: “The beginning of a]ll [the trappers] and hunters is the First [Man.” The reader flags pressure/uncertainty: “pressed toward a spiritual faculty of tracking concealed evils/falsities; somewhat uncertain.” This is a genuine metaphor/damage difficulty rather than a governance list (no ranks, stations, jurisdictions).

findings.diagnosis: Insertion of administrative numeration and territorial distribution into a functional conflict line. The core ‘fighters begin from the Living Spirit’ is correspondential; the clause about distributing “five sons” “from place to place” introduces Mani-style administrative deployment (inventory + assignment) and made the spiritual reading lean on numerological smoothing.
findings.evidence: Text: “…of] all fighters is [the] Living [Spirit]… who has distribu[ted about] his five sons from place to place.” The reader’s stumble is diagnostic: “Five sons translated by number as sufficiency… ‘from place to place’ rendered as distinct functions/degrees.” That is exactly the kind of forced harmonization expected when an administrative deployment formula is embedded in a functional maxim; the narrative flows as a litany without needing a fivefold stationed bureaucracy.
findings.scope:
Remove the deployment clause:
Excise: “, who has distribu[ted about] his five sons from place to place.”

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential pair: building and bearing/support are taught by function (architect/builder; porter/pillar). No governance vocabulary; the spiritual reading proceeds without strain.
findings.evidence: Text: “The beginning of all the archit[e]cts and builders is the Great Builder…” and “the first of all the porters… is the Pillar of Glory… [who bears up the worlds].” The reading is smooth and mechanically functional (“formative powers… ultimate supports”), indicating the substrate voice is intact here.

findings.diagnosis: Expansion at a seam via christological identification and an explanatory gloss. The bracketed naming “Jesus the Splendour” and the appositional gloss “or the one who delivers” look like an overlay clarifying an older functional title (‘the Deliverer’) by attaching an institutionalized name and a didactic explanation. The reader could make it work, but only by abstracting away from the historical/nominal layer.
findings.evidence: Text: “The beginning of [all] the deliverers [is Jesus the Splendour]; or the one who delivers, as he frees…” The whole chapter is a litany of primordial functions/titles; here we get the classic seam marker: (1) bracketed explicit identification, (2) a self-gloss “or…”, (3) a mini-definition. The reading notes the mechanism but had to generalize: “Divine truth made manifest in clarity… freeing by utterance/presence,” which works better if the line simply names the functional ‘Deliverer’ without the christological pinning and σχολιον-style gloss.
findings.scope:
Excise the identifying/glossing expansion while retaining the functional deliverance line:
Remove: “Jesus the Splendour]; or the one who delivers,”

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential close (despite damage in ¶10): ‘Virgin of Light’ as receptivity and ‘Light Mind’ as awakening/gathering are functional descriptions, and the reading did not report narrative rupture.
findings.evidence: Text: “The beginning of every wisdom of truth is the Virgin of Light” (broken ending acknowledged by reader) and “the Light Mind; who is the awakener… gatherer in…” The reader’s notes indicate stable functional mapping (“untainted receptivity,” “awakener… gatherer”), not governance.

textual_criticism.summary: 8 findings: 5 clean correspondential confirmations (¶2, ¶4, ¶5, ¶7-¶8, ¶10-¶11), 3 disruptions diagnosed as mixed-voice expansions. Recommended excisions: (1) ¶3’s king/realm/steward-ordainer administrative addendum, (2) ¶6’s ‘five sons… from place to place’ deployment clause, (3) ¶9’s christological identification + gloss (‘Jesus the Splendour… or the one who delivers’). No full overlay blocks requiring annotation; remaining difficulties are genuine metaphor/damage rather than textual intrusion.

changes_summary: Applied the critic’s excision recommendations in three places: (1) ¶3 removed the administrative addendum (“king… realm… steward and ordainer…”) per Finding 2 to preserve the correspondential maxim. (2) ¶6 removed the deployment clause about distributing “five sons… from place to place” per Finding 5, leaving the functional source-line intact. (3) ¶9 removed the identifying/glossing expansion (“Jesus the Splendour]; or the one who delivers,”) per Finding 7; the remaining sentence was minimally smoothed only as needed after excision to avoid a dangling connector while keeping the deliverance clause unchanged in substance.
